description.value:
Prerequisite: Cursed Energy Score 20+

Your soul is rotten, and your cursed energy shows that. As an action, you release your cursed energy and creatures within 100 ft must make a Wisdom saving throw against your cursed energy DC. On a success, they can feel your cruelty but are not shaken by it. On failure, they are frightened and receive one of the following detriments for 1 minute:

  • They hesitate to act due to your suffocating presence, their ability checks, saving throws, and attack rolls are reduced by your Cursed Energy modifier.

  • Your power makes them become paralyzed in fear, they have a disadvantage on your saving throws.

  • If the creature's CR or level is equal to or higher than your level, they make this saving throw with advantage. If the creature's CR or level is 3 or more below your level, they make this saving throw with disadvantage.

A creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of their turn. Once a creature passes this saving throw, it becomes immune to this effect for 24 hours.

effects.name: Suffocating presence (−CE mod to checks, saves, attacks)
effects.description: Ability checks, saving throws and attack rolls are reduced by the caster's CE modifier.
